title: Constructing longer snakes and improved asymptotic bounds in hypercubes
summary: We give snakes that are longer than the previous best known in dimensions 13 through 20 and improve the general lower bound for every dimension $d \geq 21$. Our explicit snakes reach 371,711 edges in dimension 20. Twenty compatible paths in that cube allow generalisation to give snakes of length at least $(17/48)2^d$ for every $d \geq 21$. Their controlled overlaps allow copies to be joined across the layers of a larger cube without creating shortcuts. Four additional paths give the same bound for coils.
